paper.title_en: 324-MHz interdigital \(H\)-mode drift tube linac for muon acceleration
paper.abstract_en: We have constructed a 324-MHz interdigital <math display="inline"><mi>H</mi></math>-mode drift tube linear accelerator (IH-DTL) with an alternating phase focusing method. This IH-DTL will be part of a muon linear accelerator (linac) being developed at the Japan Proton Accelerator Research Complex for a precise measurement of the muon anomalous magnetic moment and a search for the muon electric dipole moment. The IH-DTL is <math display="inline"><mrow><mn>1.45</mn><mtext>  </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></math> long and accelerates muons from <math display="inline"><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>v</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.08</mn></math> to 0.28. Low-power tuning was performed using six slug tuners, which reduced the peak-to-peak on-axis field error to <math display="inline"><mrow><mn>1.4</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow></math>. Following 94 h of high-power conditioning, the IH-DTL demonstrated stable operation at the nominal peak power of <math display="inline"><mrow><mn>390</mn><mrow><mtext>  </mtext></mrow><mi>kW</mi></mrow></math> and a duty factor of 0.1%, corresponding to the designed accelerating field (<math display="inline"><msub><mi>E</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></math>) of <math display="inline"><mrow><mn>3.6</mn><mrow><mtext>  </mtext></mrow><mi>MV</mi><mo>/</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></math>. This paper presents the construction, low-power rf tuning, and high-power performance of the 324-MHz IH-DTL.
